angle: Римская вилла в Помпеях во время ночного дождя, атриум и бассейн имплювий. Факт: дождевую воду собирали через отверстие в крыше в подземную цистерну. Слова: The rain is warm. The water is cold. You touch the door. The air smells good. The rain touches the leaves. You hear the water. The garden roof is low. The floor is made of stone. The rain falls inside. The drop touches the water. Your hand touches the stone. The house is calm. You step under the low ceiling. Your hand follows the wall. The air smells of water. The stone rim is open. You rest your knee on the stone. You wait for a drop. You hear the drop. The warm light shows the way. You stand beside the rim. You walk to the light. There is a wooden bench. The lamp is near the bench. Your sleeve smells of rosemary. The water holds a little light. The street is far away. The light reaches the rim. You rest on the dry bench.
